decisions.reason: As a good fit with the firm's modular sensing platform and now promoted on its own page, it looks promising enough that the low cost of keeping the option open outweighs the still-limited uncertainty.
Its continued dedicated presentation and strong fit with industrial measurement and control suggest revealed demand, so management would keep investing lightly rather than exit.

The relay module fits the automation portfolio but has weaker visible traction than the stronger launches, so it is worth keeping for now mainly because the option value remains and the carrying cost is likely modest.
Because it was only launched in 2024 and likely shares the firm's existing modular architecture, management would keep it on the market until more evidence arrives rather than abandon it too early.

Although a remote service has ongoing support costs, it is strategically aligned with the firm's expansion in charging and energy management, so the upside of learning and ecosystem building favors keeping it.
